bundle.shortDescription: PC telemetry, drivers and cache cleanup
bundle.longDescription: Nexum is a BIOS-style Windows 10/11 command center: real-time CPU/GPU/RAM/fan telemetry, storage and S.M.A.R.T. health, a full driver and BIOS inventory with export and backup, and a conservative cache cleanup with an audit log. Nexum sends no data anywhere.
